name: deweloperuch-mcp
description: Nieoficjalne dane deweloperuch.pl: ceny ofertowe mieszkań z historią, ceny transakcyjne RCN, statystyki GUS i NBP. Unofficial, read-only access to deweloperuch.pl data: asking prices with history, RCN transaction prices, GUS and NBP statistics.
long_description:
Pytaj asystenta AI o nowe mieszkania w Polsce: ceny ofertowe deweloperów z historią zmian, ceny transakcyjne z Rejestru Cen Nieruchomości (RCN) oraz statystyki GUS i NBP. Trzynaście narzędzi tylko do odczytu.

Ask an AI assistant about new-build apartments in Poland: developers' asking prices with their history, transaction prices from the Real Estate Price Register (RCN) and GUS and NBP statistics. Thirteen read-only tools.

**Nieoficjalne, tylko do odczytu. / Unofficial and read-only.** This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by deweloperuch.pl, GUS or NBP. It never creates or changes anything on the service, sends at most 1 request per second, caches responses and stops by itself after a 401, 403, 429 or a captcha. Please ask narrow questions; the service is run by other people. Data accuracy is not guaranteed and nothing here is a valuation or advice.

macOS and Linux only (the request limiter needs file locks that Windows lacks). Source code, documentation and the CLI: https://github.com/MBratkowski/deweloperuch-mcp

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Finds cities, districts and streets by a name fragment and returns city_slug.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: A page of developers' apartment offers in a city or the whole of Poland, with price, area, price-per-m², district, status and price-drop filters and sorting.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: One offer with its full price history and price flags (lowest price in 30/90 days, suspicious reduction).

tools.name: search_investments
tools.description: Investments of a city (averages, sorting, filter by developer) or by name across Poland.

tools.name: get_investment
tools.description: An investment with its developer, average prices and a list of offers.

tools.name: search_developers
tools.description: Finds developers by a name fragment and returns developer_slug.

tools.name: get_developer
tools.description: A developer profile: summary, investments with active offers and cities.

tools.name: get_market_statistics
tools.description: Offer-market statistics of one city: counts, price, price per m² and area distributions, the largest developers.

tools.name: get_transaction_statistics
tools.description: Transaction prices (RCN) of a city by month or quarter.

tools.name: rank_locations
tools.description: A ranking of places or powiats by RCN transactions and price per m².

tools.name: get_building
tools.description: A building from the RCN with its units and transactions.

tools.name: estimate_property_value
tools.description: An approximate apartment value at a point from nearby RCN transactions.

tools.name: get_government_statistics
tools.description: Official GUS and NBP time series (dwellings, NBP prices, unemployment, wages, demography) for Poland, aggregates and 66 cities.
